passages.quote:
These guides are for employers, employees and their representatives who are associated with applications and complaints under the Information and Consultation Regulations. The guides contain:

a summary of the relevant legislation

a list of the applications or complaints that can be made to the CAC

a description of the statutory process

an explanation of the action the CAC will take

The legislation is in The Information and Consultation of Employees Regulations 2004.
